given: a stock table already migrated to batch_number and serial_number columns
then: a combined inventory_code is reconstructed from the canonical location plus the split-out batch_number and serial_number, restoring the pre-migration schema shape

independence.rationale: Prior ACs concern the forward path; this asserts the distinct reversibility outcome. The up path could be fully correct while the down path is missing or reconstructs the code wrongly, and vice versa, so it is independently breakable.
